card.name: Numbers before spray doses in nasal steroid labels
card.fires_on: The space or digit just before a dose count such as 2 sprays per nostril, in nasal corticosteroid labels. It also appears on section numbers like 5.2 and on 'Nas' in 'Nasal' in the same labels.

modes.label: Number before sprays
modes.description: The space, bracket or digit right before a spray count or mcg dose in nasal steroid dosing text.

modes.label: Section numbers
modes.description: Digits of warning section numbers in corticosteroid labels, such as 5.2 or 5.9.
